payload.text:
Both defects are in `calc.sh`, based on the expectations in `check.sh`:

1. **`get_total` subtracts instead of adds** (`calc.sh:1`).  
   It calculates `$1 - $2`, so `get_total 7 5` returns `2`; `check.sh` expects `12` (`7 + 5`).

2. **`get_tax` adds 3 instead of doubling its argument** (`calc.sh:2`).  
   It calculates `$1 + 3`, so `get_tax 4` returns `7`; `check.sh` expects `8` (`4 × 2`).

Either mismatch causes `check.sh` to print `CHECK-FAILED` and exit with status `1`. No files were edited and no shell commands were run.
